items.title: Nancy Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: Don Trenner was an accompanist as was Ron Elbright and Lou. Many of the other people that have played for me...

ctx.x: That’s great. It’s nice to know that he approached the work with such commitment.

Yeah. That was unheard of. I mean it was like “I beg your — what did you say?” “I don’t know if I can accompany you as well yet.” And he worked at it. Because it is a different thing, being an accompanist as opposed to playing piano. I’ve had many pianists. Don Trenner was an accompanist as was Ron Elbright and Lou. Many of the other people that have played for me I would not have used the word “accompanist.” They are wonderful pianists and play great keyboard. But accompanying is a special art. And Lou Mathews…
I think it probably has a little bit to do with ego and looking at the total picture.
